TALK_TO_LOOP: Haddii kale, fadlan la wadaag sheekadaada hadda.
REUSE_DETAILS_BUTTONS: Fadlan isticmaal badhanada hoose, ama ku qor 'Haa' ama 'Maya' in aad ka jawaabto
PERSONAL_DETAILS: Haa waa hagag, waad ku dhawdahay inaad dhamayso. Waxaan jecelnahay in aan ku weydiinno 4 suʼaalood oo gaaban oo adiga kugu saabsan. Tani waxay naga caawineysaa in aan sheekadaada u helno dadka saxda ah.
DONT_REUSE_DETAILS: Hagaag, miyad doonesa in ad kajawaabto su'alahan markale?
GREETINGS: 👋 Hi! Kani waa adeeg toos ah oo lagu wadaago ra'yi-celinta ku saabsan khibradaada ururada deegaankaaga.
PROMOTE_DESCRIPTION: Waayahay Loop waa madal aad kula wadaagto oo aad ka jawaabto arrimaha adiga kugu khuseeya. Waxaad wax badan oo ku saabsan Loop ka heli kartaa shabakadeena www.talktoloop.org
END_OF_SERVICE: Tani waa dhamaadka adeeggan iswada. Waxaad nala wadaagi kartaa fariin kale wakhti kasta adiga oo gujinaya badhanka hoose.
THANKS: Wad kumahadsantahay isticmaalaya Loop si kor loogu qaado codkaaga iyo in la abuuro isbeddel wanaagsan. Waxaan hadda dib u eegi doonaa oo aan daabacnaa sheekadaada 24-48 saacadood gudahood, sida caadiga ah si ka dhaqso badan. Waxaan kuu soo diri doonaa jawaabo marka aan soo helin iyaga. Nabad gelyo. Si aad mar labaad u bilowdo ku qor 'Loop' ama garaac badhanka hoose waqti 😃 kasta
